keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Paulo Henrique (Marítimo).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Marítimo 0, Santa Clara 1. Tiago Ribeiro (Santa Clara) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Guilherme Romão.
Djé Tavares (Santa Clara) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Paulo Henrique (Marítimo).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Marítimo 0, Santa Clara 1.
Second Half begins Marítimo 0, Santa Clara 1.
Delay in match because of an injury Djé Tavares (Santa Clara).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Santa Clara. João Vasconcelos replaces Djé Tavares because of an injury.
Delay in match because of an injury Guilherme Romão (Santa Clara).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Santa Clara. Tiago Duarte replaces Guilherme Romão because of an injury.
Goal! Marítimo 0, Santa Clara 2. Vinícius Lopes (Santa Clara) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Emanuel Moreira with a through ball.
Fran Vieites (Marítimo) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Marítimo. Ibrahim Alani replaces Rodrigo Andrade.
Substitution, Marítimo. Simo Bouzaidi replaces Mons Bassouamina.
Gábor Szalai (Marítimo) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Marítimo. Israel Ayuma replaces Gábor Szalai.
Substitution, Santa Clara. Sorriso replaces Vinícius Lopes.
Substitution, Santa Clara. Welinton Torrão replaces Brenner.
Substitution, Santa Clara. Henrique Silva replaces Fernando.
Substitution, Marítimo. Maurice Boakye replaces Raphael Guzzo.
Substitution, Marítimo. Samuel Bamba replaces Martín Tejón.
Sorriso (Santa Clara) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Tiago Ribeiro (Santa Clara) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Simo Bouzaidi (Marítimo) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Marítimo 0, Santa Clara 2.
